evidence.document: Huaxing MF/RJ specification, sections 4 and 5 (reviewed online)
evidence.rule: 1% five-band code for 33 ohm: orange, orange, black, gold, brown.

marking.appearance_status: Documented five-band code; stripe spacing and shades are illustrative.

recipe.appearance_status: Generic KiCad axial geometry with bent leads at 7.62 mm pitch. Beige coating is the requested illustrative finish; the Huaxing specification states blue.

studio.note: Electronics adaptation of the screw product studio: three softboxes, orthographic framing, neutral floor and filmic highlights. Does not claim identical Blender AgX colour management.
